'''Fussballclub St. Gallen 1879''', widely known as '''FC St. Gallen 1879''' or '''FCSG''', is a Swiss professional football club based in [[St. Gallen]], in the Canton of [[Canton of St. Gallen|St. Gallen]]. Formed in 1879, it is the oldest football club still in existence in Switzerland and continental Europe. The club has won the Swiss championship and the [[Swiss Cup]] twice each.

The team competes in the [[Swiss Super League]], the top tier of Swiss football. Since 2008, the club has played its home games at the [[Sitterstadion]]. Their home colours are green and white, and their nickname is '''Espen'.''"}}
